items.headline: Alibaba releases Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash
items.summary: Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash is a native omni-modal model accepting text, image, audio and video with 1M-token context, available on Alibaba's Qwen platform with a Realtime variant. Alibaba reports average benchmark gains of over 26% versus Qwen3.5-Omni-Plus.
